scope: One actual Qwen construction of Matrix rain from an English-only author document

authoring.model_requests: Original step sentences plus generated implementation interfaces, finite examples and explicitly selected prior code

baseline.failure: Frame construction repeatedly placed trail cells on their leader row

revision: Split character construction, column construction and frame composition into separate model tasks; preserve earlier grammar and failure records

actual_run.correction: Trail direction corrected by Qwen within its native retry budget

observed_helper_use.scope: Separate instrumented execution of the accepted bodies on the standard canvas
observed_helper_use.declared_edge_not_observed: heads to movement; heads inlines wrapping, while trails calls movement

limits: Bounded supported English vocabulary, not arbitrary English verification
Finite checks of this exact artifact, not a universal correctness proof or model benchmark
Selected dependencies constrain context and runtime availability, not mandatory helper calls on every path
The accepted head function inlines wrapping instead of calling the selected movement helper; the trail function calls movement, so all nine functions contribute to the final program
Qwen produces the implementation and frame data; the existing character player supplies drawing, playback timing and controls
Per-ask output-token limits are not currently forwarded to Ollama; global model settings were preserved
